Politica di Condivisione delle Risorse

A set of security rules and access controls governing how digital resources such as data, storage, and APIs are shared among users, groups, or external entities.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Politica di Condivisione delle Risorse?

In this glossary, Politica di Condivisione delle Risorse refers to: A set of security rules and access controls governing how digital resources such as data, storage, and APIs are shared among users, groups, or external entities.

How is Politica di Condivisione delle Risorse used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Applica la politica di condivisione delle risorse per limitare l'esposizione di dati sensibili tra tenant cloud e limitare l'accesso di terze parti tramite gateway API."

Definition

A set of security rules and access controls governing how digital resources such as data, storage, and APIs are shared among users, groups, or external entities.

Operational example

Apply resource sharing policy to restrict sensitive data exposure between cloud tenants and limit third-party access via API gateways.
